summary: This document updates the MPLS Transport Profile linear protection mechanism in APS mode defined in RFC 7271. It adds rules for initializing the Protection State Coordination logic, the state machine that decides which path carries traffic, and for operating in this mode.

eli5.summary: It fixes some start-up rules for a backup system so that two ends of a link agree from the beginning about which path to use.

questions: psc state machine aps mode updates
